about_bio: Laura is an Australian film media creator based in Paris and the creator of Laura Loves Horror, a rapidly growing YouTube channel dedicated to horror, thrillers and dark cinema.
podcast_description: A new space for horror obsessions, dark cinema, movie-night debriefs and the things that keep us awake afterwards.
press_copy: Laura Loves Horror is an independent film media platform created by Australian filmmaker and creator Laura. We cover horror, thrillers, dark cinema and film culture through reviews, video essays, reactions and event coverage.
contact_copy: For press screenings, premieres, film campaigns, sponsorships and creative collaborations.
